high_level_description: The image depicts a single object: a wooden side table with a square top. The table has a rich, dark brown finish, giving it a warm and polished appearance. The top of the table features an intricate design resembling a sunburst or a flower with radiating petals, centered around a circular motif. The sides of the table are open, revealing vertical slats that create a lattice-like pattern, adding to its decorative appeal. The table stands on four curved legs that are also made of wood and have a similar dark brown finish as the rest of the table.
